summary: Make the low-density pages follow the screen size and unify controls: the steps (--s, --wrap) are defined once in theme.css; Today, the detail drawer, the profile view, the learning-map page and drawing, project settings, project creation, settings and the weekly report scale text, controls, spacing and width; the library and knowledge-base workspace keep their current size. The detail drawer gets two control sizes (main 40, small 34, select equal), one filled primary and a visible project hint; a .btn.tiny cascade bug is fixed. The Today route panel becomes a card with a segmented 按学习图推荐 | 普通排序 switch, progress bar and a real button; the map page uses the same switch with a stated reason when it is disabled.
scope_note: Branch feature/route-mode on top of 0941099. Front-end only; stage 2 of 4.

budget_impact.rationale: Stylesheet and page changes only; no model call, data or network.
budget_impact.before: Fixed pixel sizes on most pages, scaling only on part of the main page, inconsistent detail-drawer controls, checkbox and bare link for the learning map.
budget_impact.after: One scale shared by the low-density pages, unchanged below 1700 px (checked element by element at 1440 px), consistent controls.
budget_impact.developer_usage: unknown; host does not expose complete aggregate developer token accounting

additional_checks.scope: PaperDigHelper.app rebuilt; window not clicked through

open_risks: Not checked on a real large display, at 3440 px, in dark mode or in the Tauri window.
The mode switch click and the Today panel switch were not exercised in a browser; they are covered by static tests.
Pixel sizes of icons, borders, radii, the reader chrome and the project overview were deliberately not converted.
